root_cause.text: The USB framework unanchors URBs before invoking the completion callback, causing resubmitted URBs in ems_usb_read_bulk_callback() to become detached from the rx_submitted anchor and escape cleanup by usb_kill_anchored_urbs() in ems_usb_close().
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly re-anchors the URB with `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted)` immediately before resubmission in the completion callback, and conditionally unanchors it only on submission failure with `usb_unanchor_urb(urb)`. The CVE description states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in ems_usb_close()."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix URB lifecycle management by anchoring before submission and unanchoring on failure, with early return on success to prevent spurious error handling.
intent_record.what: Added usb_anchor_urb() call before usb_submit_urb(), added early return on successful submission, added usb_unanchor_urb() on failure path, and simplified the final else-if condition to else.
intent_record.how: The change anchors the URB to the device's rx_submitted anchor before submission, ensuring proper lifecycle tracking. On successful submission (retval == 0), the function returns early, avoiding unnecessary error handling. On submission failure, the URB is unanchored to clean up the anchor reference. This prevents resource leaks and ensures the URB is properly tracked by the device's anchor list during its lifetime.

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable construct is present in the ems_usb_read_bulk_callback() function. At the 'resubmit_urb' label (line ~550), the function calls usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC) to resubmit the URB without first anchoring it. The URB was originally anchored in ems_usb_start() via usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted) at line ~820, but the USB framework unanchors URBs before invoking completion callbacks. When ems_usb_read_bulk_callback() resubmits the URB at line ~552, it does so without re-anchoring it via usb_anchor_urb(). This causes the resubmitted URB to become detached from the rx_submitted anchor. Consequently, when ems_usb_close() calls unlink_all_urbs() which invokes usb_kill_anchored_urbs(&dev->rx_submitted) at line ~875, the resubmitted URBs escape cleanup because they are no longer in the anchor. The fix would require calling usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted) before usb_submit_urb() in the resubmit path, but this is not present in this commit.
